en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a large outdoor beer‑garden or café terrace with many round tables and chairs arranged in rows. People, including families and children, stroll among the tables. To the left are multi‑storey buildings with wooden balconies and shopfronts; in the background is a wooded hillside and rocky slope. The caption "Meierei im Lößnitzgrund" appears at the lower right.
